snippet.title: Baking Bustle Collector's Edition
snippet.description:
Alawar Entertainment whips up a delicious new time management challenge! Keep this power team on its toes as it races around the kitchen to feed famished customers!

Bake up a storm on an epic cooking adventure that spans the world of food! Join Ashley and Scott as they tackle the culinary challenge of their lives in restaurants that serve everything from scrumptious pancakes and gourmet burgers to tasty tacos and succulent soups. Can you crush the challenges that lie ahead of you? Download and play Baking Bustle today!
